name: Data storyteller
summary: Precision quantitative storytelling: multi-column data cards, animated metric counters, comparative progress meters, and crisp wipe transitions.

forbidden: bounce, elastic or back overshoot on any entrance (R1)
fabricated or unverified quantitative claims presented as real data
visual clutter exceeding four active data points per scene

frame_checklist: Numbers animate monotonically from zero to target value during take
Comparative bars show accurate relative proportions matching voice narration
Safezone margin guarantees metric labels are unobstructed by UI controls
Data sources and metric units are clearly labeled
licence_notes: Procedural SVG charts and HTML metrics; zero external charting libraries.
